name: E-commerce orders (sample)
description: Synthetic online-store orders 2024-2025 with a planted Q4-2025 revenue drop.
examples: Why did our revenue decline last quarter, and which customer segments contributed most?
Which product category saw the largest increase in discounting recently?
Which region has the slowest shipping, and is the difference significant?
Are there data quality problems such as missing values or outliers?

name: Seattle weather 2012-2015
description: Daily precipitation, temperature, wind and weather type in Seattle.
source: NOAA Global Historical Climatology Network, via vega-datasets
examples: Which month of the year is the wettest in Seattle, and how much rain falls then?
Is the daily maximum temperature trending up or down over 2012-2015?
Does wind speed differ between weather types, and is the difference significant?
Are there data quality problems such as missing values or outliers?

name: US employment by sector 2006-2015
description: Monthly US employment (thousands) for 23 sectors, covering the 2008-2009 recession.
source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics, via vega-datasets
examples: In which month did total nonfarm employment reach its lowest point, and how much had it fallen from its peak?
Is monthly manufacturing employment trending up or down, and when did the biggest shift happen?
How did construction employment change between 2007 and 2010?

name: Iowa electricity generation 2001-2017
description: Yearly net electricity generation in Iowa by source (fossil fuels, nuclear, renewables).
source: US Energy Information Administration, via vega-datasets
examples: How did the share of renewable energy in Iowa's electricity generation change from 2001 to 2017?
Which energy source grew the most between 2001 and 2017?
Is yearly fossil fuel generation trending down?

name: Palmer penguins
description: Body measurements of 344 penguins of three species on three islands in Antarctica, 2007-2009.
source: Gorman, Williams & Fraser (2014), Palmer Station LTER; palmerpenguins package
examples: Which penguin species has the highest body mass, and is the difference significant?
How does flipper length differ between islands?
Are there data quality problems such as missing values or outliers?
